build_OFA_model: build an OFA multimodal model for caption, vqa, or refcoco tasks with encoder and decoder configs
predict_OFA: run the OFA model predict method on images with data samples to generate predictions
create_Trie: create a Trie data structure with an eos token for constrained beam search decoding
apply_constraint_apply_constraint: apply constraint masking on logits using a Trie and decoder prompts during beam search
post_process_OFA: post process OFA model outputs to decode captions, answers, or bounding boxes from tokens
